title: fix(clawrouter): honor selected endpoint model capabilities
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes routed vision models appearing text-only and endpoint limits being ignored when ClawRouter supplies versioned native capability facts.

## User Impact

Chat discovery uses the selected Responses, Chat Completions, Messages, or Gemini streaming endpoint's text/image inputs and limits. Other endpoints cannot lend their capabilities. The router pricing output cap still bounds output.

## Why This Change Was Made

Consume the existing native-capabilities.v1 contract instead of relying on row-level input and model-name guesses. Older catalogs retain their fallback. This is campaign F04; it advertises no new router transport. Release-note context is here because OpenClaw's changelog is release-owned.

Simplify pass retained one projection owner and two boundary regressions. The test-line allocation covers 108 added lines for endpoint isolation, malformed metadata, and output-cap behavior.

## Evidence

- Frozen base: 31ad71a8addc1d42fbc5478f7e114860f5cbf6c7.
- Node syntax checks and git diff --check passed; commit-hook formatting passed.
- Independent autoreview: GPT-6 Astra, high, P0–P2, scoped-clean on the local candidate. Subsequent edits were formatting and the matching test-line allocation.
- Focused tests, typecheck, lint, and real Gateway/provider proof are pending. gwt rejected the available dependency source because its workspace link escapes the install; no dependency install or bypass was performed. Test wall time and CI seconds are unavailable.
- Required next proof: ClawRouter catalog/transport tests, native-model-facts tests, and exact-head CI on a qualified source.
- Deployment: none. Draft only; campaign integration owner controls landing.
